name: final-proxispeak
description: ProxiSpeak: Geospatial Proximity Audio Ecosystem with WebRTC, HTML5 Canvas, MongoDB, and Redis

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w backend && npm run test:unit -w frontend
